sources.quote: council has approved a new Pet Establishment licence, scheduled to take effect on 1 February 2027, that replaces the pet shop category
sources.title: Pet Establishments – City of Toronto
sources.evidence: Effective February 1, 2027, a new Pet Establishment licence type will be introduced that replaces the current Pet Shop licence category and creates new requirements for other pet-related businesses, including those that board, breed, train, and groom animals. You will need to meet requirements for one or more endorsements based on the services your business provides: Animal Daycare/Boarding/Training endorsement, Pet Grooming endorsement, Overnight Animal Keeping endorsement.

sources.quote: Quebec requires a MAPAQ permit for anyone keeping fifteen or more cats or dogs
sources.title: Permis pour chats, chiens et équidés | Gouvernement du Québec
sources.evidence: To be an owner or keeper of 15 cats or dogs, or more, it is mandatory to obtain a permit, whether the animals are intended for sale or not. The total of 15 animals or more can be composed of cats, dogs, or both. Category 1 is for 15 to 49 cats or dogs, and Category 2 is for 50 cats or dogs or more.

sources.quote: Google caps how many areas you may list, wants them set by city or postal code rather than a radius, and expects the footprint to stay within a sensible drive of your base
sources.title: Manage your service areas for service-area & hybrid businesses - Google Business Profile Help
sources.evidence: You must specify your service area by city, postal code, or another type of area, rather than as a radius distance. You can have up to 20 service areas. The boundaries of your overall area shouldn't be more than about 2 hours of driving time from where your business is based.

sources.quote: virtual offices are not eligible at all
sources.title: Guidelines for representing your business on Google - Google Business Profile Help
sources.evidence: If your business rents a physical mailing address but doesn't operate out of that location, also known as a virtual office, that location isn't eligible for a Business Profile. Service-area businesses can't list a virtual office unless that office is staffed during business hours.

sources.quote: Ontario's Provincial Animal Welfare Services Act
sources.title: Animal welfare | ontario.ca
sources.evidence: The Provincial Animal Welfare Services Act (PAWS Act) came into force on January 1, 2020. The PAWS Act and its regulations help ensure that animals are protected and treated in a humane manner, with protections including setting out basic standards of care that apply to all animals covered under the act: adequate and appropriate food, water, medical attention and care; ventilation, light and protection from the elements; sanitary conditions and space to enable natural movement and exercise.

sources.title: Bylaws related to dogs | City of Calgary
sources.evidence: The Responsible Pet Ownership Bylaw (47M2021) helps ensure that cats, dogs, their owners and neighbours live together in safety and harmony. Cats and dogs three months or older are required to have a City of Calgary licence; the bylaw limits pet ownership to a maximum of six cats and/or six dogs per household.

sources.quote: because that breaches Google's policies and the testimonial provisions of the federal Competition Act
sources.title: False or Misleading Representations and Deceptive Marketing Practices
sources.evidence: If the product is promoted by the use of testimonials or is endorsed by influencers, the Bureau expects the testimonials to be true, accurately conveyed, and provided by actual consumers who have no material connection with the advertiser unless such a connection is properly disclosed. Astroturfing refers to the practice of creating commercial representations that masquerade as the authentic experiences and opinions of impartial consumers, such as fake consumer reviews and testimonials.

sources.quote: Under CASL, implied consent from an existing business relationship expires two years after the last transaction
sources.title: From Canada’s Anti-Spam Legislation (CASL) Guidance on Implied Consent | CRTC
sources.evidence: If a recipient has made a purchase or lease of goods, services, land or interest in land within the two-year period immediately before the day on which the message was sent, there may be an existing business relationship in which case you will be able to send CEMs for the period specified (either 2 years or six months following the last transaction date). The implied consent period is typically 2 years after the event that starts the relationship (e.g. purchase of a good).
